title: Bring your work with you
summary: Drop files into the terminal, bring your Codex history into Matrix, and open organization drives in the desktop app.

highlights.title: Files in the terminal
highlights.body: Paste files, drag them in or attach them to a terminal, so your agent can work with them right away.

highlights.title: Import your Codex conversations
highlights.body: Bring local Codex conversations into Matrix as private chats and pick up where you left off.

items.text: Organization drives are available in the desktop app.
Dictation now comes with a monthly allowance.
Inbox Triage can apply Gmail labels in batches.
Links to apps and agent artifacts in chat open more naturally in the desktop app.
Settings explains access status more clearly and remembers your agent switches.
The retired Symphony app has been removed.
The desktop app keeps its agent routes, drafts and file navigation.
The desktop app stays connected to your computer when it is busy.
Matrix AI shows up in the model picker, and your own agent routes are kept.
Shared projects work reliably on mobile and in the browser.
Hermes turns on correctly when no messaging channel is set.
The matrix CLI can connect to a shell from an interactive terminal again.
